section_summary: This section documents U.S. State Department and SCAP processing of entry clearance and military permits for commercial representatives, international officials, and private individuals seeking to enter occupied Japan. It covers bilateral applications involving Burma, Argentina, South Africa, Turkey, Peru, Brazil, the United Kingdom, and international bodies such as the UN Food and Agriculture Organization. Key topics include procedures under SCAP circulars, the use of third-country protective power channels for diplomatic representations, vetting of applicants with suspected Axis or Communist ties, and policy announcements regarding Japanese commercial travel abroad.

subfiles.about: Notifying the Burmese Chargé d'Affaires that entry clearance into Japan was granted to U Thein and U Hla Thwin.
subfiles.summary: The Department advises that military authorities approved sixty-day entry for Burmese trade representatives U Thein and U Hla Thwin.
subfiles.title: Note to the Burmese Chargé d'Affaires regarding Entry Clearance for U Thein and U Hla Thwin
subfiles.to: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim of Burma

subfiles.about: Returning William A. Mustaki's unused military permit to the Army Department because of his absence in Europe.
subfiles.summary: Chappell returns William A. Mustaki's military permit, noting he is in Europe and his firm will re-apply later.
subfiles.title: Letter to Lt. Col. J. D. Scott Returning Military Permit for William A. Mustaki

subfiles.about: Recording an attorney's notification that William A. Mustaki cannot use his military permit and will resubmit later.
subfiles.summary: Attorney Pendleton informed Commerce that Mustaki is in Europe; permit returned and re-application planned for early 1949.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Files regarding Return of Permit for William A. Mustaki

subfiles.about: Submitting an application on behalf of William A. Mustaki for permission to visit Japan for business development.
subfiles.summary: Application for William A. Mustaki to represent Interchange of America in Japan for commercial conferences and cotton business.
subfiles.title: Application for Permission to Visit Japan for William A. Mustaki

subfiles.about: Transmitting Commerce Department approval of Sterns Incorporated's Japan travel application for O. C. Hellmuth.
subfiles.summary: Commerce approves Japan travel application for Argentinian representative O. C. Hellmuth of Sterns Incorporated subject to SCAP clearance.
subfiles.title: Memorandum Transmitting Approved Travel Application for O. C. Hellmuth

subfiles.about: Notifying State Department of military entry clearance for Felipe Sanchez of C.F. Sharp & Co.
subfiles.summary: Army CAD certifies military clearance for Felipe Sanchez to enter Japan for sixty days between November 10 and December 10.
subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Clearance for Felipe Sanchez

subfiles.about: Instructing the Consul at Hamburg that Martje Tetens cannot enter Japan because her father cannot support her.
subfiles.summary: The Department informs Hamburg that SCAP investigation determined Martje Tetens' father cannot provide adequate support in Japan.
subfiles.title: Instruction to American Consul at Hamburg regarding Martje Tetens

subfiles.about: Recording telephone notification from CAD that theater clearance was granted for Felipe Sanchez.

subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Files regarding Theater Clearance for Felipe Sanchez

subfiles.about: Instructing the Embassy at Manila to inform Felipe Sanchez of his military clearance to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: The Department instructs Manila to provide Felipe Sanchez a certified copy of telegram in lieu of passport clearance statement.
subfiles.title: Telegram to American Embassy Manila regarding Felipe Sanchez

subfiles.about: Reporting SCAP press release announcing policy permitting Japanese commercial representatives to travel abroad.
subfiles.summary: Despatch transmits SCAP press release announcing that Japanese commercial representatives may travel abroad under Far Eastern Commission policy with non-Japanese sponsorship.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 724 on Travel Abroad of Japanese Commercial Representatives

subfiles.about: Transmitting application for Carlos Detlev Gualterio Ketelhohn to enter Japan for commercial purposes.
subfiles.summary: Argentine Embassy forwards Carlos Ketelhohn's application for a four to six-week commercial visit to Japan.
subfiles.title: Diplomatic Note and Application for Carlos Detlev Gualterio Ketelhohn

subfiles.about: Transmitting Carlos Ketelhohn's application to Army CAD for submission to SCAP.
subfiles.summary: State Department forwards Argentine national Ketelhohn's travel application to the Army for SCAP consideration.
subfiles.title: Letter to Lt. Col. J. D. Scott regarding Carlos Ketelhohn

subfiles.about: Notifying State Department of military entry clearance for Andries Stockenstrom Tancred.

subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Clearance for Andries Stockenstrom Tancred

subfiles.about: Informing the South African Legation that military authorities approved entry for Andries Tancred.

subfiles.about: Reporting that Czech national Josef Zuna, traveling to Japan, is considered Communist by security police.
subfiles.summary: Singapore reports Josef Zuna departed for Bangkok en route to Japan; security police consider him Communist with Czech contacts.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 229 from Singapore regarding Josef Zuna

subfiles.about: Informing Bank Line Transport & Trading Co. of Laurence Beattie's entry clearance for Japan.
subfiles.summary: State Department notifies Bank Line that Beattie received military clearance, with instructions cabled to Hong Kong Consulate General.

subfiles.about: Confirming military entry clearance for Laurence D. M. Beattie of Bank Line Transport & Trading Co.

subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Clearance for Laurence D. M. Beattie

subfiles.about: Applying for permission for Laurence Beattie to visit Japan to explore shipping and trade agency prospects.
subfiles.summary: Application submitted on behalf of Laurence Beattie to investigate shipping and commodity import-export business in Japan.
subfiles.title: Application for Permission to Visit Japan for Laurence D. M. Beattie

subfiles.about: Transmitting Laurence Beattie's travel application and requesting expedited processing.
subfiles.summary: Commerce San Francisco Regional Office forwards Beattie's travel application, recommending expedited processing while he waits in Hong Kong.
subfiles.title: Memorandum Transmitting Travel Application for Laurence Beattie

subfiles.about: Notifying State Department of Commerce approval of Laurence Beattie's Japan travel application.
subfiles.summary: Commerce Far Eastern Branch transmits approved application for British representative Laurence Beattie subject to SCAP approval.
subfiles.title: Memorandum Approving Travel Application for Laurence Beattie

subfiles.about: Reporting on inactive status of Brasiltur travel project and proper protective power channels for Brazilian applicants.
subfiles.summary: Embassy Rio reports projected Brasiltur tour of 800 Japanese is inactive, and applications should proceed via Portuguese mission in Tokyo.

subfiles.about: Certifying entry clearance for UN FAO representative Dr. Peng Cheng Hsu.
subfiles.summary: Army CAD clears Dr. Peng Cheng Hsu for seven-day visit to Japan as official UN FAO representative.
subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Clearance for Peng Cheng Hsu

subfiles.about: Instructing Embassy Nanking to provide entry clearance documentation to Dr. Peng Cheng Hsu.
subfiles.summary: State Department directs Nanking Embassy to provide FAO official Dr. Peng Cheng Hsu certified copy of clearance telegram.
subfiles.title: Telegram to American Embassy Nanking regarding Peng Cheng Hsu

subfiles.about: Clarifying procedures for trade entrant clearance through country of firm location rather than nationality.
subfiles.summary: Department clarifies that British national Bethell's application should have been processed via Swiss authorities where his firm is located.
subfiles.title: Instruction to American Consulate Geneva regarding Edmond Laurence Bethell

subfiles.about: Certifying military clearance for O. C. Hellmuth of Sterns Incorporated.
subfiles.summary: Army CAD confirms sixty-day entry clearance for Argentinian representative O. C. Hellmuth between November 18 and December 18.
subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Clearance for O. C. Hellmuth

subfiles.about: Applying for permission for O. C. Hellmuth to visit Japan to re-establish pre-war business connections.
subfiles.summary: Sterns Incorporated application for Director O. C. Hellmuth to visit Japan to re-establish export-import trade.
subfiles.title: Application for Permission to Visit Japan for O. C. Hellmuth

subfiles.about: Instructing Consulate Shanghai to furnish O. C. Hellmuth clearance documentation for Japan entry.
subfiles.summary: Department authorizes Shanghai Consulate to issue certified copy of telegram to O. C. Hellmuth for sixty-day Japan visit.
subfiles.title: Telegram to American Consul Shanghai regarding O. C. Hellmuth

subfiles.about: Authorizing Consulate Hong Kong to deliver clearance documentation to Laurence Beattie.
subfiles.summary: Department instructs Hong Kong Consulate to furnish Laurence Beattie certified telegram copy in lieu of standard passport statement.
subfiles.title: Telegram to American Consul Hong Kong regarding Laurence Beattie

subfiles.about: Acknowledging Department memorandum regarding permanent Brazilian entry visa granted to Yoshitaro Suzuki.
subfiles.summary: Brazilian Embassy acknowledges memorandum concerning Yoshitaro Suzuki's permanent visa, transmitted to Foreign Ministry in Rio.
subfiles.title: Diplomatic Note No. 271 regarding Yoshitaro Suzuki

subfiles.about: Reporting disapproval of entry application for Martje Tetens due to inadequate parental support.
subfiles.summary: Army action slip disapproving Martje Tetens' Japan travel because investigation showed her father cannot adequately support her.
subfiles.title: Action Slip Disapproving Travel for Martje Tetens

subfiles.about: Transmitting application of Rudolf Herrnstadt to visit Japan for commercial trade purposes.
subfiles.from: Legation of the Union of South Africa
subfiles.summary: South African Legation transmits naturalized citizen Rudolf Herrnstadt's application for admission to Japan sponsored by Commerce Department.
subfiles.title: Diplomatic Note Transmitting Application for Rudolf Herrnstadt

subfiles.about: Applying on behalf of Rudolf Herrnstadt for business visit to Japan to buy goods and secure agencies.
subfiles.summary: Application for two-month visit to Japan to purchase textiles and conclude agencies for Frank & Hirsch subsidiary.
subfiles.title: Application for Business Visit to Japan for Rudolf Herrnstadt

subfiles.about: Recording inquiry and confirmation of commodities Rudolf Herrnstadt intends to purchase in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Mellor notes South African Legation confirmed Herrnstadt seeks textiles and piece goods, which satisfied Army CAD requirements.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Files regarding Rudolf Herrnstadt

subfiles.about: Forwarding Rudolf Herrnstadt's trade application to Army CAD for transmission to SCAP.
subfiles.summary: State Department transmits South African sponsored application of Rudolf Herrnstadt to Army for theater consideration.
subfiles.title: Letter to Lt. Col. J. D. Scott regarding Rudolf Herrnstadt

subfiles.about: Specifying trade commodities that Ektas Turk Limited intends to buy and sell with Japan.
subfiles.summary: Turkish Embassy lists commodities Ektas Turk Limited plans to export and import in connection with Zeki Keribar's trip.
subfiles.title: Diplomatic Note specifying Commodities for Ektas Turk Limited

subfiles.about: Transmitting specified commodity details regarding Zeki Keribar's Japan application to Army CAD.
subfiles.summary: Department forwards Turkish Embassy's statement of proposed export and import items for Zeki Keribar to Army CAD.
subfiles.title: Letter to Lt. Col. J. D. Scott regarding Zeki Keribar

subfiles.about: Recording file charge-out for decimal file 894.111/11-2348 to Mrs. Mellor.
subfiles.summary: Division of Communications and Records charge-out slip recording file charged to Mrs. Mellor on June 6, 1949.
subfiles.title: File Charge-Out Sheet for 894.111/11-2348

subfiles.about: Advising that Carlos Ketelhohn should apply through Swedish channels protecting Argentine interests in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Army CAD advises that Ketelhohn should apply through Swedish Embassy, which represents Argentine diplomatic interests in Japan.
subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Argentine Protective Power Channels for Carlos Ketelhohn

subfiles.about: Informing Argentine Embassy that travel applications should be submitted through Swedish protective power channels.
subfiles.summary: Department explains that under protective power arrangements, Argentine applications for travel to Japan should go through Swedish channels.
subfiles.title: Note to Argentine Ambassador regarding Protective Power Channels

subfiles.about: Inquiring whether an American citizen's German-born wife can obtain clearance to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Myers inquires if his German-born wife can obtain entry documents to accompany him if he accepts Army service in Japan.
subfiles.title: Letter and Envelope from Kenneth L. Myers regarding Visa for German-Born Wife

subfiles.about: Informing Kenneth L. Myers that his wife's German nationality does not prevent entry to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Chappell states German nationality does not bar a military permit; advises applying to Interim Office for German Affairs.
subfiles.title: Letter to Kenneth L. Myers regarding Dependent Entry

subfiles.about: Transmitting Shanghai reports on O. C. Hellmuth's background and requesting SCAP review of his clearance.
subfiles.summary: Department forwards confidential Shanghai reports concerning Hellmuth's background to CAD, requesting SCAP re-evaluate his entry clearance.
subfiles.title: Letter to Lt. Col. J. D. Scott requesting Review of Clearance for O. C. Hellmuth

subfiles.about: Reporting allegations that O. C. Hellmuth was a wartime collaborator and recommending withholding clearance.
subfiles.summary: Shanghai reports Hellmuth appears to have been collaborator; withholding clearance delivery pending Department instructions.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 2519 from Shanghai regarding O. C. Hellmuth

subfiles.about: Informing Consulate Shanghai that Hellmuth security reports were sent to SCAP by mail for review.
subfiles.summary: Department advises Shanghai that CAD forwarded security reports to SCAP by mail for clearance review.
subfiles.title: Telegram to American Consul Shanghai regarding O. C. Hellmuth

subfiles.about: Recording that Army issued military permit to Ken Hyun without notifying State Department.

subfiles.title: Note for the Files regarding Ken Hyun Permit

subfiles.about: Confirming entry clearance for Korean FAO representative Ken Hyun and requesting estimated time of arrival.
subfiles.summary: Sebald reports Ken Hyun cleared for seven days in Japan with billeting at Commercial Hotel; requests ETA.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 274 from Tokyo regarding Ken Hyun

subfiles.about: Reporting that Victor Kelly Bashi already entered Japan before notice arrived that firm withdrew sponsorship.
subfiles.summary: Bangkok reports Victor Kelly Bashi received clearance copy months earlier and is likely already in Japan; airgram arrived late.
subfiles.title: Airgram A-294 from Bangkok regarding Victor Kelly Bashi

subfiles.about: Recording South African Legation's request to postpone Andries Tancred's entry period to February 1949.
subfiles.summary: Horrocks informed Mellor that Tancred cannot use current clearance and requested a new clearance valid in February 1949.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on Entry Dates for Andries Tancred

subfiles.about: Expressing appreciation for prompt handling of Laurence Beattie's entry permit to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Bank Line thanks State Department for rapid clearance processing, noting Laurence Beattie has arrived in Tokyo.
subfiles.title: Letter from Bank Line Transport & Trading Company regarding Laurence Beattie

subfiles.about: Returning confidential Shanghai communications regarding O. C. Hellmuth to Division of Protective Services.
subfiles.summary: Army CAD returns confidential Shanghai despatch and telegram regarding O. C. Hellmuth to Mr. Chappell.
subfiles.title: Memorandum Returning Shanghai Documents regarding O. C. Hellmuth

subfiles.about: Forwarding Burmese note requesting transit visa assistance in Manila for MP U Tha Din.
subfiles.summary: Embassy Rangoon transmits Burmese Foreign Office request for Philippine transit visa assistance for Member of Parliament U Tha Din.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 37 Transmitting Burmese Request for U Tha Din Transit Visa

subfiles.about: Informing South African Legation that Andries Tancred's entry clearance was rescheduled to February 1949.
subfiles.summary: Department notifies South African Legation that military authorities approved Tancred's sixty-day entry between February 1 and March 1, 1949.
subfiles.title: Note to South African Chargé d'Affaires regarding Rescheduled Entry for Andries Tancred
subfiles.to: Chargé d'Affaires ad interim of the Union of South Africa

subfiles.about: Confirming modified entry period for Andries Stockenstrom Tancred for February 1949.
subfiles.summary: Army CAD modifies Andries Tancred's clearance, authorizing entry between February 1 and March 1, 1949.
subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Rescheduled Clearance for Andries Stockenstrom Tancred

subfiles.about: Certifying military clearance for Standard Vacuum Oil Company representative John Macdonald.
subfiles.summary: Army CAD clears British national John Macdonald for sixty-day Japan visit between December 1 and January 1.
subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Clearance for John Macdonald

subfiles.about: Instructing Embassy London to furnish John Macdonald clearance documentation for Japan entry.
subfiles.summary: Department directs London Embassy to furnish Standard Vacuum representative John Macdonald certified telegram copy for entry.
subfiles.title: Telegram to American Embassy London regarding John Macdonald

subfiles.about: Advising Martin Bronfenbrenner to apply as newspaper correspondent rather than academic researcher to enter Japan.
subfiles.summary: Whitman advises Professor Bronfenbrenner that Army officials suggest applying as a daily newspaper correspondent rather than researcher.
subfiles.title: Letter to Martin Bronfenbrenner regarding Entry Procedure

subfiles.about: Inquiring about means to obtain entry permission into Japan for economic research under an SSRC fellowship.
subfiles.summary: Professor Bronfenbrenner seeks advice on overcoming MacArthur's ban on professors to conduct post-war economic recovery research in Japan.
subfiles.title: Letter from Martin Bronfenbrenner regarding Research Visit to Japan

subfiles.about: Requesting departure instructions enabling Peruvian citizen Leonardo Kanashiro to return to Peru from Japan.
subfiles.summary: Peruvian Embassy requests U.S. good offices to authorize travel of Peruvian citizen Leonardo Kanashiro from Japan to San Francisco.
subfiles.title: Diplomatic Note regarding Repatriation of Leonardo Kanashiro

subfiles.about: Clarifying identity distinction between Leonardo Kanashiro and persons named in earlier correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Department and Peruvian Embassy confirm Leonardo Kanashiro is distinct from individuals previously named Nakashiro; outlines required documentation.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation regarding Leonardo Kanashiro

subfiles.about: Detailing requirements for U.S. good offices in arranging Leonardo Kanashiro's departure from Japan to Peru.
subfiles.summary: Department agrees to assist Kanashiro's departure upon receipt of Japanese address, nationality proof, prepaid passage, and U.S. transit funds.
subfiles.title: Note to Peruvian Chargé d'Affaires regarding Departure of Leonardo Kanashiro

subfiles.about: Certifying entry clearance for Thomas George Morris of California Texas Oil Co., Ltd.
subfiles.summary: Army CAD certifies entry clearance for Thomas George Morris between December 10 and January 10.
subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Clearance for Thomas George Morris

subfiles.about: Requesting notification to British Consulate in Shanghai of military permit granted to Thomas George Morris.
subfiles.summary: Caltex representative notes entry permit was granted for Morris as Terminal Superintendent and requests cable to British Consulate Shanghai.
subfiles.title: Letter regarding Military Permit for Thomas George Morris

subfiles.about: Instructing Consulate Shanghai to furnish Thomas George Morris entry clearance documentation.
subfiles.summary: Department directs Shanghai Consulate to provide Caltex representative Thomas George Morris certified copy of entry telegram.
subfiles.title: Telegram to American Consul Shanghai regarding Thomas George Morris

subfiles.about: Certifying entry clearance for Turkish representative Zeki Keribar of Ektas Turk Limited.
subfiles.summary: Army CAD certifies sixty-day entry clearance for Zeki Keribar to enter Japan between December 15 and January 15.
subfiles.title: Memorandum regarding Clearance for Zeki Keribar

subfiles.about: Arranging delivery of theater clearance to Zeki Keribar through American Consulate General at Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: Because Turkey has no diplomatic post in Hong Kong, State Department agrees to cable Keribar's clearance to U.S. Consulate there.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on Clearance Delivery for Zeki Keribar

subfiles.about: Instructing Consulate Hong Kong to furnish Zeki Keribar certified clearance telegram for entry into Japan.
subfiles.summary: Department instructs Hong Kong Consulate to furnish Turkish trade representative Zeki Keribar certified telegram copy in lieu of passport statement.
subfiles.title: Telegram to American Consul Hong Kong regarding Zeki Keribar
